rules: copied: the value of the key in the file. derived: a formula over other values. A key part in brackets selects one list item by its fields ("a=x+y" matches the list [x, y]).
A time is the median wall time of a result in the baseline (one controlled session). A ratio is sqll / other tool; below 1, sqll is faster. A tie is not faster.
text: the form that docs/decisions/s3-exit.md shows. A ratio has 3 digits, a time sum in seconds has 2 digits.

criteria.text: STONES.md S3 exit: sqll passes all cases that the base passes.
criteria.note: The base cases are the S1 dialect suite and the native tests of the base. The S1 rule cases of CP01, CP03, and CP04 are not base cases: the native base has no linter, config reader, CLI, or fix. The human owner checks this reading at stone approval.

criteria.text: STONES.md S3 exit: sqll is not slower than sqruff on any benchmark (G3.5), on the benchmarks that sqll runs.
criteria.note: sqll runs start and parse. Lint and fix are unsupported until S5 (later.lint.unsupported, later.fix.unsupported).

criteria.text: CONSTITUTION.md G3.4 on the benchmarks that sqll runs: sqll is faster than sqlfluff on each start and parse benchmark.
Not met yet, for later stones: G3.4 and G3.5 on lint and fix, and the G3.5 total over all benchmarks.

exit.dialects.formula: s1.dialects.exact == s1.dialects.total and the known-failure check has 0 new failures and 0 unexpected passes

exit.native_base.formula: t18.base.passed == t18.base.tests and cargo test of the base gave exit code 0. The sqll side is the list check (scripts/s3/base_native_tests.py check: CI job build and scripts/verify): each base test that passes in the base passes in sqll

g3.benchmarks.formula: count of the start and parse benchmarks

g35.pairs.formula: count of the start and parse benchmarks where sqruff is valid

g35.no_pair.formula: the start and parse benchmarks where sqruff is not valid

g35.slower.formula: the pairs where time.sqll is not below time.sqruff

g35.worst.formula: the pair with the largest ratio to sqruff

g35.median_ratio.formula: the median of the ratios to sqruff of the pairs

g35.below_target.formula: count of the pairs with a ratio to sqruff below t14.ratio_below (the T14 target: no tie within the noise)

g34.not_faster.formula: the start and parse benchmarks where sqlfluff is not valid or time.sqll is not below time.sqlfluff

g34.worst.formula: the benchmark with the largest ratio to sqlfluff

sum.start.sqll.formula: sum of time.<id>.sqll over the start pairs

sum.start.sqruff.formula: sum of time.<id>.sqruff over the start pairs

sum.parse.sqll.formula: sum of time.<id>.sqll over the parse pairs

sum.parse.sqruff.formula: sum of time.<id>.sqruff over the parse pairs

later.lint.unsupported.formula: count of the sqll lint results with the status unsupported

later.lint.reason.formula: the reasons of the sqll lint results

later.fix.unsupported.formula: count of the sqll fix results with the status unsupported

later.fix.reason.formula: the reasons of the sqll fix results

later.all_benchmarks.formula: count of the benchmarks of the baseline
